description.value: La Forêt is a cozy café and bakery chain with roots going back to 2013, known for its spacious, forest-themed spaces and a menu spanning espresso drinks, brunch platters, croissants, and waffles. The Austin location in Coquitlam is the newest of three Lower Mainland outposts, offering the full La Forêt experience including signature velvet matcha drinks and Benedict platters. Touring cyclists will find a welcoming sit-down spot with substantial food options and a relaxed community atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms La Forêt is an active multi-location café and bakery; the Austin location at 1135 Austin Avenue is explicitly identified on the site as being in Coquitlam, not North Vancouver as the OSM community field states. The website offers online pre-ordering and pickup, confirming takeout. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website explicitly identifies the Austin location (1135 Austin Avenue) as being in Coquitlam — the OSM community tag appears incorrect.
OSM name is 'La Foret' (no accent); the business consistently styles itself 'La Forêt' on its website.
Phone number +1-236-553-1173 could not be confirmed via website content — the contact page did not list per-location phone numbers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café and bakery with a confirmed website and online ordering; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a substantial meal or coffee.
